title: I'll Let Myself In: Tactics of Physical Pen Testers
summary: Deviant Ollam, head of a physical penetration testing team, presents tactics for getting into buildings, from bypassing door levers with a wire to defeating bank doors. He argues that physical security is often surprisingly weak.
why: HN recommends it as an entertaining overview of physical pen testing, and cites it when threads discuss how easily doors and locks are bypassed.

quote.text: Deviant Ollam's talks are always first class.
